name: ER – Emergency (EDIS)
description: Emergency department: registration, MOPH ED Triage, physician and nursing assessment, trauma / resuscitation / procedures / investigations / fast-track pathways when needed, observation, consultation, transfer, disposition, SBAR handover and incident record. Vital signs and medications use the case chart.

fields.label: GCS
fields.formula: IF(gcs_e='4', 4, IF(gcs_e='3', 3, IF(gcs_e='2', 2, IF(gcs_e='1', 1, NULL)))) + IF(gcs_v='5', 5, IF(gcs_v='4', 4, IF(gcs_v='3', 3, IF(gcs_v='2', 2, IF(gcs_v='1', 1, IF(gcs_v='t', 1, NULL)))))) + IF(gcs_m='6', 6, IF(gcs_m='5', 5, IF(gcs_m='4', 4, IF(gcs_m='3', 3, IF(gcs_m='2', 2, IF(gcs_m='1', 1, NULL))))))

sections.title: Decision points · การตัดสินระดับ

fields.label: Vital signs in the hospital's danger zone
Suggested level
fields.formula: IF(dp_lifesaving, 1, IF(dp_high_risk OR dp_altered OR dp_severe_pain, 2, IF(resources = '2plus', IF(dp_danger_vitals, 2, 3), IF(resources = '1', 4, IF(resources = '0', 5, NULL)))))
fields.description: Follows the published decision order (life-saving → high risk → resources). Danger-zone limits and any local criteria are set by the hospital.

sections.description: Decision order of MOPH ED Triage / ESI v4. Confirm against the edition the hospital uses.

sections.title: Triage level · ระดับความฉุกเฉิน

fields.label: Level (number)
fields.formula: IF(triage_level='1', 1, IF(triage_level='2', 2, IF(triage_level='3', 3, IF(triage_level='4', 4, IF(triage_level='5', 5, NULL)))))

fields.label: Reason for the level (เหตุผลประกอบการคัดแยก)
Why the level differs from the suggestion

sections.title: Re-triage · คัดแยกซ้ำ

rules.assert: ISBLANK(level_num) OR ISBLANK(suggested_level) OR level_num = suggested_level OR NOT ISBLANK(override_reason)
rules.message: Give a reason when the level differs from the suggested level
